ctbids-49744-5814149.description:
Add a touch of historic American elegance to your dining table or silver collection with this beautifully curated 6-piece vintage table set, featuring premier craftsmanship primarily by the iconic Gorham Manufacturing Company. This classic mid-century assembly includes an elegant pair of short candlesticks, a heavy napkin band, a rare miniature individual caster shaker, and a pair of decorative individual glass shakers.
•          Full Set Inventory & Specifications:
o  Pair of Gorham Weighted Candlesticks
o  Stamped "GORHAM STERLING WEIGHTED" with pattern markings on the base rims.
o  Features a classic flared column profile with detailed gadroon/rope-bordered edge trims.
o  Weight: 186 grams (combined pair).
o  Gorham Sterling Silver Napkin Ring        "GORHAM STERLING" on the smooth inner surface.
o  Heavy solid sterling silver band featuring an elegant, classic script monogram engraved on the front face.
o  Total Weight: 29 grams of solid sterling silver.
•          Rare Gorham Miniature Individual Caster Shaker
o  Stamped on the base with Gorham's historic three-shield hallmark (Lion Passant, Anchor, Gothic letter G), "STERLING", and pattern number A3136.
o  Charming 1920s-era petite all-metal personal individual shaker with a dome-top lid, standing at approximately 1.75 inches tall.
o  Weight: 9 grams of solid sterling silver.
•          Pair of Patterned Glass Shakers with Sterling Caps
o  Lids are distinctly stamped "STERLING" along the lower collar rim.
o  Beautiful clear pressed-glass columns with matching solid silver screw-on tops.
o  Total Weight: 44 grams (combined pair, including glass).
•          All pieces are in good, authentic vintage condition with a warm, natural patina showing minor surface age wear appropriate for historical table silver. No heavy structural silver damage or deep dents. Please Note: There is a small dent present on the top of one of the individual glass salt and pepper shakers. This minor cosmetic flaw is visible upon close inspection but does not compromise the structure or functionality of the piece.

ctbids-49744-5815065.description:
Indulge in the exquisite artistry of the late 19th to early 20th century with this magnificent export-grade Balkan/Ottoman-style belt buckle. Known traditionally as a pafta or girdle clasp, this piece beautifully exemplifies the rich ethnographic jewelry traditions of regions like Bulgaria, Greece, and North Macedonia.
•          Crafted with high-level precision, the structural framework features a heavy-duty central junction bar made of solid silver, explicitly verified by a clear, authentic STERLING stamp on the crescent-shaped interlocking hook. The front face show cases a striking three-part polylobed layout, highlighting a prominent central medallion framed by two intricate, wing-like side panels.
•          The entire facade is adorned with gorgeous metal openwork filigree, fine wire scrolls, and delicate floral motifs. It is heavily embellished with polished, round green and purple glass cabochons. In regional bridal and festive attire, these colorful faux gems were historically used to signify wealth and offer protection against evil.
•          This high-quality folk revival or grand-tour export item is remarkably intact. All the colored glass cabochons remain original and securely set, and the delicate openwork shows exceptional preservation. It serves as a premier addition to any antique costume, silver filigree, or ethnographic jewelry collection.
•          Measurements: Measure about 5” long by 3”wide
•          Condition: Antique condition with a beautiful, natural aged patina. The filigree work is complete, and all glass elements are intact. The reverse belt slider mechanism and closure hook function smoothly.
•          Estimated Value: $300 - $800

283826016.description:
Lot of 4 Vintage Briar Tobacco Pipes Forcaster Worthmore Amphora Old Mariner
This lot includes four vintage tobacco pipes with distinct features and brands. The Forcaster Imported Briar-Mini pipe has a textured, carved briar wood bowl and a black mouthpiece with a silver accent, showing visible wear. The Worthmore England pipe features smooth, polished briar wood and a black stem with signs of age and use. The Amphora Extra 738 pipe has a straight, elongated stem with a slightly bent brown briar wood bowl and a darker mouthpiece, also used with wear. The Old Mariner John Middleton-Phila pipe presents a classic bent shape, smooth brown finish, and black mouthpiece, with some visible wear. All pipes are made of briar wood and are suitable for collectors of vintage smoking accessories.
